text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Damn it...! The win slipped right through 
my fingers—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Bubble Gum Fellow was so close. But 
that mid-race speed was crazy, so we've 
still got plenty to look forward to...!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
…………Running like this in a GⅠ. I knew you 
were special too, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...I need to reset. First, I have to 
accept the reality of the situation.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (There was definitely something there.)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(My strongest distance is from mile to 
medium...! There's no mistaking it...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Then the race I must run from here on 
is—)

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: Ngaaaah! Bubble-chan was so close...!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"Still, she made her presence known. 
Bubble did a splendid job as our 
vanguard."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"Lapis. Cure. We're following right 
behind. The 'Hopeful Stakes'... Let's show 
them what we're capable of."

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: Of course. We will win in Bubble's place!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Let's sweep the podium, one-two-three! Ah, 
but first place is mine, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Sorry. I... couldn't win today.
choice_data_list:
Still, looks like you got something out of 
it.

Still, looks like you got something out of 
it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
choice_data_list:
Your eyes are still burning, looking 
straight ahead to what's next.

Your eyes are already burning with focus 
on what's next.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Haha—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I didn't lose for nothing! I 
definitely gained something to build on 
for next time. So—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely produce results next 
time! Look forward to it...!

And so, though the Asahi Hai FS was a 
frustrating result, valuable lessons were 
learned—
—The next day.

During a meeting to discuss his Classic 
Year rotation, Bubble Gum Fellow shared 
what he felt from the Asahi Hai FS—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I'm more certain than ever now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I was told that mile to medium-distance 
races are where I can unleash my true 
strength the most.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...That's precisely why we have to decide, 
right?
choice_data_list:
...The question is what to do about the 
Classic Triple Crown, huh.

...The question is what we should do about 
the Classic Triple Crown, right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

The royal road of races that birthed 
countless legends, the "Classic Triple 
Crown Route," is comprised of three 
prestigious races.

The turf 2000m Satsuki Sho at Nakayama 
Racecourse. The turf 2400m Japanese Derby 
at Tokyo Racecourse. And then—

Held at Kyoto Racecourse, Turf 3000m. The 
long-distance race that crowns the final 
leg of the Triple Crown: the Kikuka Sho.

Hypothetically, if Bubble Gum Fellow were 
to run in this race, it would inevitably 
be a tough battle in terms of distance 
suitability.

And this is something faced by every 
Umamusume with distance aptitudes like 
Bubble Gum Fellow, who ran in the Classic 
races in the past.

"...If one only considers winning, 
avoiding the Kikuka Sho due to aptitude 
can be considered a rational decision."

"However, if you're trying to prove your 
strength, that is another story entirely—"

—Racing history tells us: there is a 
"strength" that can only be proven by 
running the Classic races.

That would be the presence of the "Triple 
Crown Umamusume" who conquered all three 
Classic races.

Their great achievement of dominating 
races from 2000m to 3000m, centered around 
the traditional 2400m distance. It will be 
etched into racing history forever.

No matter how much time passes, they will 
always have a seat whenever the 
'strongest' is discussed.

"Only a hero who commands such awe can be 
called a 'Triple Crown Umamusume'—"

Therefore, if one wishes to prove their 
strength, they should run in all of the 
Classic Triple Crown races. It is a fact 
that such a viewpoint exists.

If Bubble Gum Fellow avoided the Kikuka 
Sho due to distance aptitude, proving her 
strength to the world would become much 
harder.
choice_data_list:
(Provided, of course, that she merely 
dodged.)

text_block_list.text:
There is one option. A prestigious race 
held at Tokyo Racecourse around the same 
time that would more than prove your 
strength without running the Kikuka Sho.

Rather than simply avoiding the Kikuka 
Sho... there is a grueling battlefield 
that only Bubble Gum Fellow can choose—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: No, sorry. It's just a hunch, but...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I think you and I are picturing the exact 
same race right now, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"So, let me hear it. From your own lips, 
Trainer. The name of the race we should 
challenge in our future."

—The old me never would have been able to 
say it.
choice_data_list: ...Our goal isn't the Kikuka Sho, but—
...Our goal isn't the Kikuka Sho, but—

text_block_list.text:
However, as Bubble Gum Fellow's Trainer 
now, I can make that difficult choice.
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Autumn). A 2000m turf 
medium-distance GⅠ race held at Tokyo 
Racecourse.

Unlike the Classic Triple Crown where only 
Classic-year runners can compete, this 
race is also open to Senior-year runners. 
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—She would have to compete against Senior 
Year horse girls whose bodies, tactics, 
and experience were far more polished than 
Classic Year runners.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And that means it's a stage to decide not 
just the strongest of a generation, but 
the strongest of an era...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I know. No Classic-class Umamusume has 
ever won the Tenno Sho (Autumn). ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Even Oguri-senpai, with her legendary 
achievements, lost to Tamamo-senpai, who 
was the strongest back then...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's why in the racing world, the notion 
that 'there is a gap in ability between 
Classic-class and Senior-class racers' is 
taken as common sense.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Still... that's exactly why...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I want to win!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely because no one has won it yet, 
it will be undeniable proof of strength to 
all who behold it...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I want to break through this 
impossibility...! I want to win and prove 
that we are the strongest!

A fist thrust straight ahead. The fiery 
heat radiating from it fuels my own 
feelings—

And so, Bubble Gum Fellow and I decided to 
forge ahead on a path no one had ever 
traveled before—

text_block_list.name: The Four Heavenly Kings
text_block_list.text: Not running in the Kikuka Sho...?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I've decided to set my sights on the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) for my Classic year's 
autumn!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, properly participating in the 
spring Satsuki Sho and getting results is 
the top priority for now. That's just a 
long-term goal, though."

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, wha~t...? I-Is that even 
allowed...?!"

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course, it's not out of the 
question. Last year, a Classic-class 
Umamusume took up the challenge and fought 
hard for 2nd place. However—"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
No Classic-class Umamusume has ever won 
before. ...And that's precisely why Bubble 
is taking on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! You guys have the Kikuka Sho, and 
I have the Tenno Sho (Autumn). If we both 
win our races—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A true era-shaking Four Heavenly Kings 
whirlwind! Right? Come on, let's all aim 
for that together!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Th-That is so true~~! Wait, that's 
seriously amazing! We totally, totally 
gotta do it!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Just for today, I agree with Lapis. If 
this happens, it'll create an unmatched 
Four Heavenly Kings whirlwind...!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even though we haven't even run in 
the Hopeful Stakes yet—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Still... Bubble is right.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, all of us together. We'll 
make next year the year of the Heavenly 
Kings!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

Together with all the members of the Big 
Four, we reaffirmed the paths we would 
take in the Classic year—
The next day—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, got a minute?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Sorry this is so sudden! But about what's 
ahead... would it be all right if I took a 
break from racing for a while...?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, I've been feeling pretty heavily 
fatigued for some reason. ...I was totally 
fine after running in the Asahi Hai FS, 
though."
choice_data_list:
Got it, let's take it easy for the rest of 
the year

text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai FS was Bubble Gum Fellow's 
first GⅠ and a grueling race. The 
aftereffects might still be lingering.

There is still time before the Satsuki 
Sho. It's best to tread carefully and 
avoid racing for the rest of the year.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I'll go ahead and do what I can 
too.

“Yes, if we stay cautious like this until 
next year's Satsuki Sho, we'll surely be 
fine.”
That's what I had thought————
